recipes.title: Cold that ignites
recipes.hook: Turn Frostbolt's Cold hits into an Ignite direction, then use an ignited enemy to detonate Gas Arrow.
recipes.mechanics: The helmet changes what Cold hit damage contributes to. Gas Arrow gas can explode when an ignited enemy touches it. This is a conditional mechanics link, not a guarantee that Frostbolt ignites.
play: Equip the helmet and establish actual Ignite application with Frostbolt.
Place Gas Arrow gas where an ignited enemy can touch it.
Check whether the application and damage feel reliable in your current patch.
conditions: Requires actual qualifying hits and Ignite application; raw Cold damage alone is not enough.
The Cold portion no longer supplies its usual Chill magnitude or Freeze buildup with this helmet.
A gas explosion still requires the ignited enemy to touch the cloud.

supports.reason: Supports the new Ignite direction by improving Flammability magnitude.
supports.tradeoff: Does not guarantee Ignite or simulate the final ailment magnitude.

supports.reason: Can strengthen Ignites once the Cold-hit Ignite route actually works.
supports.tradeoff: Reduces hit damage; reassess application reliability and clearing.

supports.reason: Lets you cast Frostbolt more frequently.
supports.tradeoff: Extra casts cost resources; no cast-rate or Energy calculation is performed.

avoid: Do not choose Deep Freeze for the helmet's Cold-to-Ignite route.

recipes.title: Lightning that freezes
recipes.hook: Use Lightning hit damage as a Freeze-buildup direction, then explore an ailment-driven Comet trigger.
recipes.mechanics: The helmet redirects Lightning hit damage toward Freeze buildup. Actual Freeze events can supply the ailment trigger's Energy; a socketed Comet is released only at its threshold.
play: Equip the helmet and verify that Spark's Lightning hits actually build Freeze.
Activate Cast on Elemental Ailment and socket Comet.
Test Energy generation against the enemies you plan to fight.
conditions: Freeze buildup is not guaranteed Freeze.
Requires enough Spirit, eligible Energy generation and the trigger threshold.
The Lightning portion no longer supplies its normal Shock chance via this modifier.

supports.reason: Extends freezes once Spark is actually inflicting them.
supports.tradeoff: Does not increase Freeze buildup or create Freeze by itself.

supports.reason: Adds more cast opportunities for the Lightning-hit generator.
supports.tradeoff: Mana and actual hit behavior can be limiting.

supports.reason: A possible spell-hit damage direction for the socketed Comet.
supports.tradeoff: Prevents Comet's critical hits; this is not a critical-hit trigger setup.

avoid: Do not assume Lightning types prove Freeze or trigger Energy.
Brutality would remove the elemental damage that this idea uses.

recipes.title: Fire that shocks

recipes.mechanics: Fire hit damage can contribute to Shock chance with the helmet. Shockchain Arrow needs a Lightning Ailment for its chain route and consumes Shock, so reapplication matters.

Use Shockchain Arrow against an actually affected target.
Plan how to reapply Shock after it is consumed.
conditions: Shock chance contribution does not guarantee Shock.
Fire damage no longer contributes to its usual Flammability or Ignite magnitude via this modifier.
Weapon and attribute requirements for the attack are outside the concept check.

Use Spark to establish a qualifying target ailment.
